title: Material Delivery vs Gantt Dependency Gap
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:ops dependency_name=* material_arrival_epoch=* dependency_need_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((material_arrival_epoch-dependency_need_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by dependency_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures material dependency gap by dependency for material deliveries.
value: Lag tracking shows which dependency create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside material deliveries.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `material dependency gap` on `reno:ops` events and aggregate them by `dependency_name`.
visualization: Table of dependency with average and worst material dependency gap.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how long things take for each dependency so you can see where material deliveries slows down.
